components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 28px; background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 10px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5b52f0; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #818cf8; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: NexaDuo's visual system presents engineering authority through precision, structural honesty, and inspectable proof. Rather than decorating pages with generic agency illustrations or toy code snippets, the interface reads like an executive engineering specification paired with a production software ledger. Deep obsidian and slate grounds create a calm, high-contrast environment where architecture telemetry, capability matrices, and real shipped product interfaces (Vaelo, mARC, Audio Blackbox) command attention.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian (#030712) and slate (#0f172a) tonal layering separated by 1px indigo-tinted hairline borders (rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12)).
Asymmetric 12-column grids (11fr / 10fr in the hero, 5fr / 6fr in section spines and featured product stages).
Solid typographic emphasis (#a5b4fc) and neutral dark elevation shadows (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)) instead of decorative neon glows or gradient text.
Product-specific sub-palettes scoped strictly to their own stage (such as Vaelo's warm amber #f5a524 on #16171a).

rules.name: The Solid Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Never apply CSS background-clip: text gradients to headings or metrics; typographic emphasis is achieved through solid color contrast (#a5b4fc) and weight.

rules.name: The Scoped Product Accent Rule
rules.body: Product-specific brand colors (such as Vaelo Amber #f5a524) remain strictly inside that product's card container and never bleed into global navigation or consulting sections.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3, h4) lead their containers directly without uppercase eyebrow labels or badge pills stacked above them. Metadata tags sit beside or below the heading.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows use neutral black alpha (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35–0.5)) with a vertical offset; never use zero-offset neon or purple glow halos (box-shadow color glows) on dark surfaces.

dos: Do synchronize every Hero, Header, or root token change between styles.css and the inline <style> block in index.html, privacy-policy/index.html, and terms-of-service/index.html.
Do bump the ?v=YYYYMMDD cache-busting query string on styles.css, i18n.js, and script.js across all HTML files whenever CSS or JS changes.
Do keep static default pt-BR copy in index.html identical to DICT.pt in i18n.js.
Do ensure at least 8px vertical and horizontal padding inside bordered or pill containers (such as .nav-container).
donts: Don't place kicker/eyebrow labels or status pills above h1, h2, h3, or h4 headings.
Don't use background-clip: text gradients or colored neon box-shadow glows.
Don't use decorative pseudo-code windows or unverified social-proof claims.
